chunks: He is the giver of life and death, and to Him you will return.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah gives life and death?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah’s absolute sovereignty over existence, linking the physical acts of giving life and causing death to the spiritual reality of resurrection. It serves as a foundational proof for the Day of Return (Ma'ad), reminding believers that all creation ultimately converges back to its Creator for accountability.
